The unit is mounted on a black stand with a foot pedal and a control knob visible on the front.
The hood has a sticker with 'EQUATOR' and 'EQUATOR 2' written on it, along with a cartoon character and some text.
The transparent chamber appears to be a water tank or reservoir, possibly for steam or water-based treatments.
The unit is in a room with a window and curtains, and there is a mannequin head in a basin nearby, suggesting a salon or spa setting.
The photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DEBORAH KINGSLEY ADEOSUN' and a timestamp '2026/10/10' which is likely a future date, possibly a typo or error.
The unit appears to be in used condition with some visible wear and dust, especially on the dome and stand.
